data.name: WhatsNewBody
data.value:
Replio 1.1.4: • Recordings with no recognised speech are no longer sent to the AI: they are named «Empty recording» and Replio offers to delete them. • A topic updates by itself after each meeting: its summary and graph are ready without pressing «Update topic». While it runs, the button shows the progress. • The «Hidden from screen share» badge shows the real state and switches with a click. • Graph: labels no longer overlap, the legend and the hint moved under the graph. • The Replio icon in the tray blinks during a recording; its menu has «Open the live transcript», «Stop recording» and «Take a screenshot». • The recording bar no longer covers the main window's input box, the «Statistics» tab is gone, «Select several» sits above the meeting list. • New meetings, topics and the knowledge base live in the .replio folder in your home folder, like .claude for Claude. Earlier data stays where it was; move it in Settings → Data and updates.
Replio 1.1.3: • Settings are split into sections: «Account», «Meetings», «Speech», «AI assistant», «Windows and look», «Hotkeys», «Data and updates». Changes are saved by themselves, there is no «Save» button any more. • Each plan sees only what it can use: on «Local» speech is recognised on the computer, on «Pro» and «Team» you can choose the recognition quality. • «Meetings (default)» in Settings apply to every topic that has no setup of its own. • Names and terms can now also be set per topic on the «How to help» tab: they are added to the common list and recognised better. • «Private» plan: AI and speech recognition run through the company's server, which the administrator connects once in the account on replio.ru. • The «Deep mode» switch is gone: it changed nothing.
Replio 1.1.2: • «Modes» are replaced by the topic tab «How to help»: meeting type (sales, interview, negotiation, stand-up, consultation or your own), how to hint and which sections to add to the summary. Meetings without a topic are set up in Settings. • The search in the header looks everywhere: topics, topic summaries, meeting summaries, transcripts, emails, the knowledge base and questions. A click opens the right place. • «Update topic» also redoes out-of-date meeting summaries of the topic and replaces «Rewrite summary» in a topic's meeting. • A limit bar in the header shows what is left today and this month: yellow when little is left, red at the very end. • «Help» opens as a small window with short cards and pictures. • Settings now have «Open account page» and «Data folder»: keep meetings, topics and the knowledge base in Yandex Disk, OneDrive or iCloud Drive to have them on all your computers. • New logo, as on the site. The plan from your account is picked up by itself.
Replio 1.1.0 — the first version. • Live hints during a call: «What to say», «What to answer», «What to ask» and follow-up questions in a separate window that is hidden from screen share. • Meeting summary, follow-up email and transcript with «Copy» buttons; screenshots are kept with the meeting. • Topics: sessions, a knowledge base (documents, folders, audio and video, your own text), «Summary», «Questions» with sources and a relation graph. One «Update topic» button parses new materials and refreshes the summary and graph. • The speech language is detected automatically for each side of the call; it can also be chosen in Settings. • Replio account: sign in on replio.ru; the key is stored encrypted on the computer. Hints, summaries and recognition run on your plan. • Updates arrive in the app: a new version shows an «Update» button. Settings and the key are kept on update. • The replio command and an MCP server for AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor): details in %AppData%\Replio\AGENTS.md.

data.name: HelpTopicStartBody
data.value: 1. Open **Settings** → **Account** → **Sign in via replio.ru** and confirm in the browser. 2. Keep **Speech language** on «Auto-detect»: Replio finds each side's language itself. 3. During your first recording open **Settings** → **Speech** → **Check sound**: both the other side and your microphone should be heard.

data.name: HelpTopicRecordBody
data.value: - Press **Start Replio** on the home screen or {START}. - Replio records the other side and your microphone. - A small panel appears over other windows. It is hidden from screen sharing. - To stop: the same button or {START}. Replio prepares the summary and the title itself.

data.name: HelpTopicHintsBody
data.value: - Show or hide the hints window with {OVERLAY}. - **What to say**, **What to ask**, **Follow-up questions**, **Recap**: an answer from the latest lines. - Your own question: type it and press Enter or {ASK}. - A screenshot for the AI: the 📷 button or {SNAPSHOT}.

data.name: HelpTopicAfterBody
data.value: - Open the meeting in the list on the home screen. - Tabs: **Summary**, **Transcript**, **Screenshots**, **Email** and **Usage**. - Every tab has **Copy**. - A meeting can be renamed, moved to a topic or deleted.

data.name: HelpTopicTopicsBody
data.value: - **+ New topic**: everything about one project or client. Drag meetings onto a topic to move them. - **Knowledge base**: **+ Documents**, **+ Folder**, **+ Media** or **+ Text**. Files can be dropped or pasted ({PASTE}). - **Update topic** redoes out-of-date meeting summaries, then the **Summary** and the **Graph**. In a meeting of a topic this button replaces «Update summary». - Ask about the topic on the **Questions** tab: the answer uses all meetings and materials.

data.name: HelpTopicDataBody
data.value: - Meetings, topics and the knowledge base live in the **data folder**: **Settings** → **Data and updates**. - Pick a folder in Yandex Disk, OneDrive or iCloud Drive, and your meetings will be on all your computers. - Nothing goes to Replio servers. Settings and the sign-in key stay separate on each computer.

data.name: HelpTopicAgentsBody
data.value:
{MAC_WARNING}Replio gives your meetings to local AI agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. The data is read only on this computer.
**Claude Code.** Run in a terminal or press **Copy the Claude Code command** below:
``` {MCP_CLAUDE} ```
**Cursor and other MCP clients.** Add to the MCP settings (`mcp.json`):
``` {MCP_JSON} ```
Then ask the agent: «find yesterday's meeting and list the tasks».
**Terminal:** `{CLI} list`, `{CLI} show last`, `{CLI} guide`.

data.name: HelpTopicTroubleBody
data.value: - **No hints or summary.** Check the sign-in and what is left in **Settings** → **Account**. - **The other side is not heard.** While recording open **Settings** → **Speech** → **Check sound**. Their sound must play through this computer's speakers or headphones. - **A hotkey does not work.** Another program took it: set a different one in **Settings** → **Hotkeys**. - Questions and ideas: hello@replio.ru.

data.value: How Replio helps in a topic

data.name: HelpTopicMeetingsBody
data.value: - Open a topic → the **How to help** tab. - Pick the **type of meetings**: sales, job interview, negotiation, team meeting, consultation or an ordinary meeting. - **How to help in meetings**: what the hints should focus on. **What to add to summaries**: which sections to add to the summary. - **Topic names and terms**: participants, companies and terms, so recognition spells them right. - Edit the texts freely: the variant becomes **Custom**. - Topics without their own setup and meetings without a topic follow **Settings → Meetings**.

data.name: HelpTopicSearchBody
data.value: - Type in the search box at the top: Replio looks through topics and their summaries, meeting titles, summaries, transcripts and emails, the knowledge base and questions. - All words must be found, in any order. - Click a result to open the right place, or press **Enter** for the first one. **Esc** closes the list.

data.name: WhatsNewBody_Mac
data.value:
Replio 1.1.4: • Recordings with no recognised speech are no longer sent to the AI: they are named «Empty recording» and Replio offers to delete them. • A topic updates by itself after each meeting: its summary and graph are ready without pressing «Update topic». While it runs, the button shows the progress. • The «Hidden from screen share» badge shows the real state and switches with a click. • Graph: labels no longer overlap, the legend and the hint moved under the graph. • The Replio icon in the menu bar blinks during a recording; its menu has «Open the live transcript», «Stop recording» and «Take a screenshot». • The recording bar no longer covers the main window's input box, the «Statistics» tab is gone, «Select several» sits above the meeting list. • New meetings, topics and the knowledge base live in the .replio folder in your home folder, like .claude for Claude. Earlier data stays where it was; move it in Settings → Data and updates. • Hotkeys are shown with ⌃ ⌥ ⇧ ⌘, the second Replio icon no longer bounces in the Dock, and «Data and updates» checks for a new version.
Replio 1.1.3: • Settings are split into sections: «Account», «Meetings», «Speech», «AI assistant», «Windows and look», «Hotkeys», «Data and updates». Changes are saved by themselves, there is no «Save» button any more. • Each plan sees only what it can use: on «Local» speech is recognised on the computer, on «Pro» and «Team» you can choose the recognition quality. • «Meetings (default)» in Settings apply to every topic that has no setup of its own. • Names and terms can now also be set per topic on the «How to help» tab: they are added to the common list and recognised better. • «Private» plan: AI and speech recognition run through the company's server, which the administrator connects once in the account on replio.ru. • The «Deep mode» switch is gone: it changed nothing.
Replio 1.1.2: • «Modes» are replaced by the topic tab «How to help»: meeting type (sales, interview, negotiation, stand-up, consultation or your own), how to hint and which sections to add to the summary. Meetings without a topic are set up in Settings. • The search in the header looks everywhere: topics, topic summaries, meeting summaries, transcripts, emails, the knowledge base and questions. A click opens the right place. • «Update topic» also redoes out-of-date meeting summaries of the topic and replaces «Rewrite summary» in a topic's meeting. • A limit bar in the header shows what is left today and this month: yellow when little is left, red at the very end. • «Help» opens as a small window with short cards and pictures. • Settings now have «Open account page» and «Data folder»: keep meetings, topics and the knowledge base in Yandex Disk, OneDrive or iCloud Drive to have them on all your computers. • New logo, as on the site. The plan from your account is picked up by itself.
Replio 1.1.0 — the first version. • Live hints during a call: «What to say», «What to answer», «What to ask» and follow-up questions in a separate window that is hidden from screen share. • Meeting summary, follow-up email and transcript with «Copy» buttons; screenshots are kept with the meeting. • Topics: sessions, a knowledge base (documents, folders, audio and video, your own text), «Summary», «Questions» with sources and a relation graph. One «Update topic» button parses new materials and refreshes the summary and graph. • The speech language is detected automatically for each side of the call; it can also be chosen in Settings. • Replio account: sign in on replio.ru; the key is stored encrypted on the computer. Hints, summaries and recognition run on your plan. • Updates arrive in the app: a new version shows an «Update» button. Settings and the key are kept on update. • The replio command and an MCP server for AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor): details in ~/Library/Application Support/Replio/AGENTS.md.
